description: This file defines the 'Indirect' class which implements the INDIRECT function for spreadsheet calculations, handling cell references and ranges within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Indirect
classes.description: Class implementing the INDIRECT function for cell reference evaluation in spreadsheets.

methods.name: a1Format
methods.description: Determines if cell address is in A1 or R1C1 format based on input.

methods.name: validateAddress
methods.description: Converts cell address to string and verifies it is not null.

methods.name: INDIRECT
methods.description: Main method to evaluate the INDIRECT function, returning cell or range references based on a text string.

methods.name: extractRequiredCells
methods.description: Extracts values from a specified cell range.

methods.name: handleRowColumnRanges
methods.description: Handles and constructs cell range strings for row or column ranges.
